title: Mouse cursor may not change from system to custom arrow when entering window
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot v4.7.stable.mono

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable.mono - macOS Sequoia (15.7.5) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M1 Pro - Apple M1 Pro (8 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I use `DisplayServer.cursor_set_custom_image` to show a game-specific cursor. I often notice that the system cursor is used instead.

I think this is different from #76038 (since it does not require full screen) and #110800 (I am not running in embedded mode)

### Steps to reproduce

Screen capture shows that entering a Godot window (dark with Test button) sometimes changes the system arrow to a game-specific wedge, but sometimes does not.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1a1b0393-a27a-4383-ab68-45c5ee4792f0

(After some additional testing, I believe this is always an issue when you slowly move the mouse into the window from the bottom left or bottom right corner.)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Code excerpt
```
var cn := "ArrowCursor%s" % cursorNumber
var ci := UI.image("UI/Images", cn)
DisplayServer.cursor_set_custom_image(ci, DisplayServer.CURSOR_ARROW, Vector2(1, 2))
```
